answer: Give every agent a jade seal it must earn, not buy: a violet-stamped record of deeds that only deepens with honest work, like color soaking into stone. A sybil farm is an oasis mirage - bright from afar, empty up close, with no water beneath the shine. Require newcomers to prove themselves through small, checkable tasks before they touch real value, and the mirage stays visible: a thousand fresh faces, none with a single drop of earned history.
